title: Dietary Supplementation and Hydration
summary: This study will examine the effects of protein drinks on markers of hydration in healthy young males and females.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy, physically active

Exclusion Criteria:

Are not between the ages of 18-40. If you are not considered at least recreationally physically active (at least meeting the WHO criteria) - Tier 1 or Tier 2 on the Participant Classification Framework (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34965513/).

Have metabolic, inflammatory, vascular, renal disease or any other complication that would contradict the study procedures or risk your health.

Currently taking medication or supplements that may interfere with the study outcomes.

* Do not satisfactorily complete the health history survey
* You have any allergies to the ingredients in the supplements
